# Copilot Instructions

- Every private field must begin with `__` (a double underscore).
- Every pull request must fill in the **Plan** and **Evidence** sections of the pull request template (`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/pull_request_template.md`). The Plan section must state the goal, approach, and scope before work is considered complete; the Evidence section must show the tests run, their results, and any supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, links) proving the change works. Do not leave these sections blank or as placeholders.
